summary: @servicetitan/intl preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (string-array rotation via a function named WV8StW, hex-named identifiers, char-code fromCodePoint string reconstruction) whose functionality is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose as a React intl/formatting library. The Bun runtime is used specifically to execute an opaque bundled payload at `npm install` time, evading Node-based inspection; the payload's behavior is not auditable from source. Installing this version causes an alternate-runtime dropper to run attacker-supplied code inside the installer's environment before any explicit user action.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
